nodes.label: Incremental Delta Install
nodes.author: Google LLC
nodes.rationale: Transfers only modified code and resources via --use-delta-install (default true) for faster incremental deployment than raw adb.

nodes.label: Profiler Intent Disambiguation
nodes.author: Google LLC
nodes.rationale: Never guess user profiling intent; clarify target artifact and recording vs analysis goal and converge on an execution plan before running workflows.

nodes.label: ADB Shell Input & Interaction Rules
nodes.author: Google LLC
nodes.rationale: Requires FOCUSED state before text entry, %s encoding for spaces, escaped shell metacharacters, and slow swipe durations to avoid dropped gestures.

nodes.label: android screen (Annotated Screenshot & Resolve)
nodes.author: Google LLC
nodes.rationale: Secondary visual inspection for WebViews or non-dumpable UI; --annotate overlays numbered bounding boxes resolved to tap coordinates via screen resolve.

nodes.label: XML Journey Test Evaluation
nodes.author: Google LLC
nodes.rationale: XML journey spec is the strict source of truth; actions must run verbatim without inferring intent, and failures terminate early with markdown evidence summaries.

nodes.label: android layout (UI Dump)
nodes.author: Google LLC
nodes.rationale: Primary inspection mechanism returning interactive/content UI elements as JSON; reduces token/image overhead compared to screenshots unless layout fails or content is in a WebView.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Recording Lifecycle
nodes.author: Google LLC
nodes.rationale: Check isRecording before stopping or pausing and handle VideoRecordEvent.Start for UI state updates rather than relying on the initial start call.

nodes.label: Immutable Builder Reassignment Pattern
nodes.author: Google LLC
nodes.rationale: CameraX fluent builder-like APIs return a new instance; ignoring the return value silently drops settings such as audio.

nodes.label: Compose Semantic UI Merging
nodes.author: Google LLC
nodes.rationale: Using semantics { mergeDescendants = true } on composite camera controls ensures screen readers announce Icon and Text as a single coherent unit.

nodes.label: Media3Effect Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Declarative Media3 effects (RgbFilter, HslAdjustment) injected via setEffects on Recorder or Preview instead of custom OpenGL pipelines.

nodes.label: AE-Mode Low Light Boost
nodes.rationale: Hardware auto-exposure brightening via CameraControl.enableLowLightBoostAsync (CameraX 1.5+, Android 15+); trades lower frame rate for increased brightness.

nodes.label: Night Mode Extension (ExtensionSessionConfig)
nodes.rationale: Uses device computational photography for high-quality stills via ExtensionsManager; ImageAnalysis is unsupported in extension sessions and may conflict with ConcurrentCamera.

nodes.label: Google Play Services Low Light Boost (SurfaceProcessor)
nodes.norm_label: google play services low light boost (surfaceprocessor)
nodes.rationale: Software-based brightening via CameraEffect and SurfaceProcessor that maintains higher frame rates for preview and video capture.

nodes.label: Structural Blueprinting
nodes.rationale: Breaks multi-file hardware-level camera features into phased implementation steps to avoid agent stalls and system timeouts.

nodes.label: PowerManager Thermal Graceful Degradation
nodes.rationale: Observes PowerManager.addThermalStatusListener to stop ML analysis, cap FPS, drop resolution, disable HDR/effects/flash, or close the session before THERMAL_STATUS_CRITICAL.

nodes.label: Perfetto Helper Scripts
nodes.rationale: Prefer official Perfetto helper scripts (java_heap_dump, heap_profile, cpu_profile, record_android_trace) over raw adb commands because they automate config pushing, daemon lifecycle, trace pulling, and fast config validation.

nodes.label: $SKILL_ROOT Environment Anchor
nodes.rationale: Defines a single session-scoped root path so workflow markdown, reference docs, helper scripts, and bundled tools resolve deterministically.

nodes.label: Bundled trace_processor Wrapper
nodes.rationale: Pinned wrapper at $SKILL_ROOT/references/perfetto/bin/trace_processor auto-downloads and caches prebuilt binaries, preventing version skew unless overridden by team environments.

nodes.label: SPAN_JOIN Materialization & Partitioning
nodes.rationale: SPAN_JOIN crashes on overlapping intervals within an input table and requires materialized CREATE PERFETTO TABLE (not CREATE VIEW) with PARTITIONED isolation.

nodes.label: Analysis Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Discovers matching analysis workflows by scanning frontmatter name keys under analysis/workflows/ and prevents silently merging distinct goals without user plan agreement.

nodes.label: Recording Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Discovers matching recording workflows via frontmatter name keys under recording/workflows/ and ensures pre-flight checks and domain profiling flags are applied without merging distinct recording goals.

nodes.label: Evidence Tagging ([SQL] / [INFERRED] / [GAP])
nodes.rationale: Distinguishes trace-backed claims ([SQL]), logical deductions ([INFERRED]), and untraced gaps ([GAP]), requiring split partial suspects to be reported transparently rather than forcing false certainty.

nodes.label: Causation vs Correlation Overlap Principle
nodes.rationale: Concurrent anomalies are causally linked only when the blocker's active execution overlaps the victim's wait interval, and traversal must follow waker/server chains across process boundaries to the leaf.

nodes.label: Systemic Confound Sweep
nodes.rationale: Thermal throttling, cpufreq capping, scheduler contention, or LMKD pressure can inflate wall-clock time without increasing instruction overhead, making healthy code look slow; always check platform confounds before concluding app inefficiency.

nodes.label: Upstream Symptom Window Expansion
nodes.rationale: Stalls in binder servers, memory reclamation, or kernel locks often begin hundreds of milliseconds before the visible frame drop; tracing the victim's first non-Running waker chain expands the window upstream to catch true co-candidates.

nodes.label: TraceConfig Merging & Atrace Rules
nodes.rationale: Each data source may appear at most once when merging configs; atrace_categories and atrace_apps flow exclusively through linux.ftrace, and buffer sizes are specified in KB rather than bytes.

nodes.label: Intrinsic Stdlib & LIMIT 0 Schema Discovery
nodes.rationale: Query __intrinsic_stdlib_objects and SELECT * ... LIMIT 0 before drafting SQL because trace_processor schemas evolve across versions; never bake unstable __intrinsic_* names into committed scripts.

nodes.label: UTID/UPID Unique Identifier Join Rule
nodes.rationale: Join on utid/upid rather than tid/pid because the OS recycles TIDs/PIDs while UTIDs/UPIDs remain unique for the trace lifetime; always join out to stable names for reporting.

nodes.label: Warm trace_processor Daemon Session
nodes.rationale: Parsing multi-GB traces takes tens of seconds; loading once via trace_processor server unix --daemonize and querying via --remote amortizes parse cost and preserves materialized tables across calls.

nodes.label: FoldingFeature Postures (FLAT, Tabletop, Book)
nodes.rationale: Uses Jetpack WindowInfoTracker and FoldingFeature.bounds to split viewfinder and controls in HALF_OPENED postures and avoid spanning preview across the hinge.

nodes.label: ViewPort and UseCaseGroup Recalculation
nodes.rationale: Updating ViewPort when fold layout changes keeps tap-to-focus and capture coordinates accurate; PreviewView internal scaling should be preferred before full rebinding due to latency.

nodes.label: CamCraft Monorepo Structure
nodes.rationale: Locked monorepo layout isolating desktop Rust workspace (camcraft-protocol, camcraft-core, camcraft-cli, camcraft-gui) and android Gradle app (protocol, camera, encoder, network, ui) alongside docs and scripts.

nodes.label: 8-Stage Vertical Slice Execution Plan
nodes.rationale: Split CamCraft development into 8 sequential vertical slices so each milestone is fully implemented and verified before advancing to the next.

nodes.label: CamCraft MVP v0.1 Vision
nodes.rationale: Free open-source alternative to paywalled webcam apps, providing 1080p-4K @ 60fps locally over USB/Wi-Fi without cloud telemetry, with native Fedora Wayland/PipeWire/v4l2loopback integration.

nodes.label: MVP v0.1 Scope Boundaries (Non-Goals)
nodes.rationale: Keep AI vibecoding focused by excluding cloud relays, AI background blur, and Windows/macOS/iOS code in v0.1, while defining VideoOutputSink/AudioOutputSink traits in Rust for future OS portability.

nodes.label: Android MVVM Unidirectional Data Flow
nodes.rationale: Keep Jetpack Compose functions dumb (rendering UiState and forwarding UiEvent) and never execute socket I/O, CameraX configuration, or MediaCodec on Dispatchers.Main.

nodes.label: CamCraft Project
nodes.rationale: Open-source local smartphone-to-PC webcam and microphone (1080p-4K @ 60fps, <35ms USB / <60ms Wi-Fi) targeting Fedora Linux (Native Rust 2024) and Android (Native Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, CameraX, MediaCodec).

nodes.label: CamCraft Vibecoding Toolchain
nodes.rationale: Single monorepo integrating Zed IDE, Hydrogen (Antigravity), Graphify knowledge graph, and Agent Skills so AI and Graphify can validate binary protocol contracts directly across Rust and Kotlin.

nodes.label: AudioCaptureEngine (Android encoder/)
nodes.rationale: Reads 48kHz 16-bit PCM mono via AudioRecord and encodes 20ms (960-sample) frames as Opus or raw PCM for ultra-low-latency USB streaming.

nodes.label: HardwareVideoEncoder (Android encoder/)
nodes.rationale: Uses MediaCodec H.264 with KEY_LATENCY=0/KEY_PRIORITY=0 and createInputSurface() bound directly to CameraX so color conversion occurs in hardware without copying frame buffers to the JVM heap.

nodes.label: v4l2loopback Output Sink (vcam)
nodes.rationale: Configures /dev/videoX via VIDIOC_S_FMT and keeps writing a static standby card frame when the phone disconnects so consuming apps like OBS and Discord never encounter I/O errors.

nodes.label: Android CameraX-to-MediaCodec Surface Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Connect MediaCodec.createInputSurface() directly to CameraX so GPU/ISP processes frames in hardware without copying YUV bytes to Kotlin CPU memory; extract csd-0 (SPS) and csd-1 (PPS) on format change and emit STREAM_VIDEO_CONFIG (0x01) before regular frames.

nodes.label: Rust Unsafe FFI Invariant Rule
nodes.rationale: Avoid unsafe except when strictly necessary for FFI (V4L2 ioctl or ffmpeg C-bindings), requiring // SAFETY comments documenting invariants.

nodes.label: Rust Zero-Copy Hot Loop & Thread Isolation
nodes.norm_label: rust zero-copy hot loop & thread isolation
nodes.rationale: Forbid per-frame Vec<u8> allocation at 60fps by using bytes::BytesMut or pre-allocated bounded crossbeam-channel ring buffers; isolate Tokio async network threads from blocking hardware decode and V4L2 ioctl threads via spawn_blocking or dedicated std::thread.

nodes.label: Rust Zero Panic Production Rule
nodes.rationale: All network I/O, video decoding, and V4L2 device writes must return Result<T, E> using thiserror for library crates and anyhow for binary crates instead of unwrap() or panic!().

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md Android Coding Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Mirror of Android rules: MVVM dumb Compose UI, hardware Surface input to MediaCodec with SPS/PPS extraction, and Foreground Service resource cleanup.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md Rust Coding Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Mirror of Rust production rules: zero unwrap/panic, zero-copy BytesMut or bounded crossbeam-channel hot loop, clippy -D warnings, and documented unsafe FFI.

nodes.label: Bounded Video Queue Frame-Drop Strategy
nodes.rationale: Use crossbeam_channel::bounded(4) in camcraft-core's Tokio network reader so stale video frames are dropped immediately on lag, keeping end-to-end latency real-time.

nodes.community_name: ML Kit Spatial Analysis & Coordinate Mapping
nodes.rationale: Standard CameraX is often restricted or insufficient on XR devices; spatial SDKs provide plane detection, depth, motion tracking, and hardware passthrough.

nodes.label: Double Rotation & Mirrored Lens Coordinate Handling
nodes.community_name: ML Kit Spatial Analysis & Coordinate Mapping
nodes.norm_label: double rotation & mirrored lens coordinate handling
nodes.rationale: ML Kit bounding boxes are relative to the rotated buffer; mapping requires imageInfo.rotationDegrees, normalized coordinates, and X-flipping for LENS_FACING_FRONT.

nodes.label: STRATEGY_KEEP_ONLY_LATEST Backpressure
nodes.community_name: ML Kit Spatial Analysis & Coordinate Mapping
nodes.rationale: Prevents queuing stale frames when ML processing exceeds 50 ms so bounding boxes do not trail behind.

nodes.label: Motion-to-Photon Latency Guardrail (< 20 ms)
nodes.community_name: ML Kit Spatial Analysis & Coordinate Mapping
nodes.rationale: Viewfinder delays exceeding 20 ms cause user nausea; requires HMD head-pose synchronization, zero-copy HardwareBuffer GPU sharing, and FrontBufferRenderer.

nodes.label: Immutable Fluent Builder Pattern
nodes.rationale: Android camera APIs use immutability to prevent race conditions in async environments; builder methods return new instances that must be chained or reassigned.

nodes.label: Camera2Interop.Extender
nodes.rationale: Applies Camera2 CaptureRequest options (such as manual exposure and ISO) to CameraX UseCases; deprecated in CameraX 1.7.0 in favor of the camera2Interop Kotlin builder.

nodes.label: StreamUseCase Optimization
nodes.rationale: Hints stream purpose (PREVIEW, STILL_CAPTURE, VIDEO_RECORD, VIDEO_CALL) to the camera HAL on Android 13+ to balance quality and power.

nodes.label: Manual Controls Phased Blueprint
nodes.rationale: Separates ViewModel ManualSettings StateFlow, CameraController mapping, and CameraSession Camera2Interop wiring with CONTROL_AE_MODE_OFF.

nodes.label: ISP Double-Work Pitfall
nodes.rationale: Running preview and video capture streams at mismatched aspect ratios forces the ISP to perform double scaling and generates excessive heat.

nodes.label: CameraXViewfinder
nodes.rationale: Native Jetpack Compose viewfinder component; avoids resizing issues caused by wrapping PreviewView in AndroidView.

nodes.label: ProcessCameraProvider
nodes.rationale: Binds camera use cases directly to a LifecycleOwner, replacing manual onResume/onPause open/release logic.

nodes.label: ImageAnalysis
nodes.rationale: Replaces Camera2 ImageReader for frame-by-frame processing; must close ImageProxy promptly and offload heavy work off the analyzer thread.

nodes.label: ImageProxy Closure Invariant
nodes.rationale: Invoking image.close() in capture and analysis callbacks is mandatory; omitting it locks the camera pipeline and blocks subsequent frames.

nodes.label: CameraX UseCase Lifecycle Abstraction
nodes.rationale: Replaces CameraDevice.StateCallback, CameraCaptureSession.StateCallback, HandlerThread management, and manual SENSOR_ORIENTATION math with lifecycle-bound UseCases.

nodes.label: Async Lifecycle Testing (IdlingResource / unbindAll)
nodes.rationale: Uses IdlingResource/CountDownLatch with explicit warm-up timeouts and @After unbindAll() to prevent Camera in Use leaks.

nodes.label: Fakes Over Mocks (FakeImageProxy / FakeAppConfig)
nodes.rationale: Mocking rapidly changing CameraX interfaces like ImageProxy or CameraInfo with Mockito creates brittle tests; Fakes verify state reliably.

nodes.label: Wearable DataClient & MessageClient Sync
nodes.rationale: Streams JPEG-compressed viewfinder frames throttled to 10-15 fps via DataClient while sending low-latency capture triggers via MessageClient and filtering nodes with CapabilityClient.

nodes.label: Vibecoding Agent Workflow Loop
nodes.rationale: Execute one vertical slice at a time, check GRAPH_REPORT.md before editing, verify with just rust-check/rust-test or android-lint/android-build, and refresh Graphify index on cross-language changes.

nodes.rationale: Selected for MVP over UDP because USB adb forward has zero packet loss (<1ms overhead) and Wi-Fi with TCP_NODELAY=true simplifies synchronizing SPS/PPS, H.264, Opus, and Control JSON without NAT traversal or fragmented NAL reassembly.
